Preference.android:title: Data options
Preference.android:summary: Clear and manage history, cookies, cache, bookmarks and site permissions.

Preference.android:title: Gestures and actions
Preference.android:summary: Menus, volume buttons, link long press, swipes, corner taps and more.

Preference.android:title: Privacy and blocking
Preference.android:summary: Ad and tracker blocking, Do Not Track, Safe Browsing.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: If off, use the pull-up menu's JavaScript button to allow it for one tab. Long press that button to manage sites that always get JavaScript.

ListPreference.android:summary: %s. If off or Wi-Fi only, the pull-up menu's image button loads them for one tab; long press it for sites that always get images.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Zoom re-flows text
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Wrap text to the screen after zooming. Can be annoying; you can bind re-flow to a gesture instead.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Wide viewport
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Let pages lay out wider than the screen instead of squeezing everything in.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Open pages zoomed out
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Zoom all the way out when a page loads. Double tap to zoom in. Works best with wide viewport.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Text auto-size
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Boost small fonts to make them readable.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Dark pages
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Ask sites for their dark theme and darken pages that have none.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Search suggestions
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Show Google suggestions while typing in the address bar. Privacy: what you type is sent to Google; addresses you visit are not.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Suggest bookmarks first
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: While typing in the address bar, list bookmarks before history.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Search engine list
EditTextPreference.android:summary: One engine per line as Name|https://address?q= . Shown when you long press the go button.

ListPreference.android:title: Tab close method
ListPreference.android:summary: %s. Long press the + button to reopen closed tabs.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Remember tabs
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Reopen your tabs the next time the browser starts.

ListPreference.android:title: Tabs kept in memory
ListPreference.android:summary: %s. Tabs beyond this are paused to save memory and reload when shown; their titles are italic.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Tabs and address at the bottom

EditTextPreference.android:title: Home page
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Where new tabs and the home button go. about:home is the built-in page.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Keyboard on new tab
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Put the cursor in the address bar when you open a new tab.

ListPreference.android:title: Certificate problems
ListPreference.android:summary: %s, when a site's security certificate is invalid.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Popups allowed
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Let sites open windows you did not tap for. You are asked each time.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: System downloader
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Download with Android's download manager. If off, downloads are handed to another app. Long press the downloads button to toggle.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Location requests
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Let sites ask for your location; you allow or deny each site.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Open links from other apps in the background
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: A link tapped in another app opens as a new tab while you stay in that app.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Keep screen on
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Keep the screen awake while the browser is in front. Fullscreen video always keeps it on.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Open YouTube links in the YouTube app
Alt + key shortcuts
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: With a hardware keyboard, Alt works like Ctrl: T new tab, W close tab, R reload, L address bar, F find.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Desktop site user agent
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Leave empty to derive one from the built-in browser engine.

Preference.android:title: More configuration
Preference.android:summary: Home page HTML and night mode colours.
